name: Number Field
description: A numeric field with stepper buttons, number formatting and limits.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the field while it is invalid, with an alert icon.

props.name: minValue
props.description: The smallest value. The decrement button dims when it is reached.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The largest value. The increment button dims when it is reached.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount the buttons, arrow keys and wheel change the value by.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the value is shown: currency, percent, unit, fraction digits.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the value is committed: on step, blur or Enter.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the camellia border and the error message.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Hides the steppers and shows the value on a muted fill.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the outlined box.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components NumberField.
